text:
Alyssa Chen: Heads-up: Scheduling an 'Integration Field Day' with LangChain / LlamaIndex + gateway vendors. Goal: showcase orchestration + marketplace flow, confirm technical checklist & partner asks. Proposed dates: Apr 14-16. Who's in to help run tech sessions and the integration booth?

Devon Patel: I'm in. Can we get a short 15m prereq call with LC folks to align on connector API? Need to verify model compatibility + streaming hooks.

Maria Gomez: I can lead partner ops. We need a marketplace preflight doc (assets, logos, SSO steps). I'll draft a checklist. @Samir can you confirm SSO flows for adapter sign-on?

Samir Khan: Yep. SSO + token exchange works. For private deployments we need a docs snippet for VPC whitelisting. I'll paste sample YAML in a sec.

Samir Khan: ```
# sample gateway connector manifest
connector:
  id: lc-lindex-adapter
  auth: oauth2
  redirect_urls:
    - https://console.redwood.ai/auth/callback
  scopes: ["generate","embeddings"]
```

Alyssa Chen: :thumbsup: Nice. Also want to lock whether we demo Dedicated fallback behavior + cost profile. Product wants per-route cost breakdown screenshots.

Devon Patel: For fallback, we should prepare a small script to simulate capacity failover. Proposed: a load script + orchestrator policy file. Snippet: `rps=200 ./load_test.sh --model=redwood-2b`

Maria Gomez: I'll coordinate partner comms. Need blurb for press: 2-3 lines + co-brand assets. Partner marketing lead is @Olga — loop her in?

Olga Martinez: On it. Will prepare co-marketing template. Quick Q: any embargo window? prefer EOW Apr 21 for joint announce.

Alyssa Chen: EOW Apr 21 works. Action items: Maria (marketplace preflight doc), Devon (failover script + runbook), Samir (SSO & manifest), Olga (co-marketing). Let's meet Tue 10am PT to finalize. RSVP asap.
